title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: the shipper signs an amended declaration (customer action)
content:
## Situation of use and capability
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product this is the action by which the shipper signs an amended dangerous-goods declaration that changes the declared gross weight of one acceptance. Only the shipper can sign its own declaration, so the action is carried out by the customer in person. One call files a new amendment declaration for the acceptance, marked as signed by the shipper and carrying the UN number, class and packing group already declared, and replaces the gross weight declared on the acceptance with the signed figure. Afterwards the acceptance shows the new gross weight, and its declaration file lists the signed amendment with its own declaration reference.

## How it is invoked
The action is sign_amended_dg_declaration_eb5287cf. It must first be unlocked and handed over by the agent (unlock_user_discoverable_tool), to be run by the customer themselves (call_user_discoverable_tool).

## Parameters
| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dg_id | reference number of the dangerous-goods acceptance being amended, as shown by the dangerous-goods acceptance lookup for the customer's booking | identifier, text |
| customer_id | customer reference number of the shipper signing the amendment, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier, text |
| booking_id | reference number of the booking the goods travel under, as shown on the acceptance record and by the booking lookup | identifier, text |
| vessel_voyage | identifier of the sailing the booking is currently allocated to (vessel name and voyage number) | copied exactly as shown by the booking lookup |
| gross_weight_kg | the new total gross weight of the dangerous goods the shipper signs for; it replaces the previously declared weight | kilograms, decimal, 1 decimal place |

## Return
The receipt lists submission_id (reference of the new signed amendment declaration), dg_id (the acceptance amended), gross_weight_kg (the declared gross weight now on the acceptance, 1 decimal place) and outcome (always signed when the amendment was filed). The call has succeeded when the receipt shows outcome signed together with the new declaration reference. No other outcome is defined for this action.

## Contract Q&A
- *Does the action change the UN number, class or packing group?* No; the new declaration carries the particulars already declared, and only the gross weight on the acceptance is replaced.
- *Can the agent run this action for the shipper?* No; it is handed over and run by the customer themselves.
